site.description: Home at night, can't sleep, want to talk but don't feel like answering messages? Leave a line anonymously on Porchlamps. No one can reply; they can only quietly light a lamp for you, glowing on Taiwan's night map.

about.title: About Porchlamps
about.description: Porchlamps is a quiet little place: when you can't sleep at night, leave a line, and someone will quietly light a lamp for you. No real names, and no one to follow.

what.0: Porchlamps is a quiet little place: when you can't sleep at night, come here and leave a line, and someone will quietly light a lamp for you.
what.1: There are no real names, no profile pictures, and no one to follow. The lines and lamps stay lit on the home page for only 24 hours.
what.2: After you light 3 lamps, you can set off a firework over a city or district, without leaving your name. When every line left in a city or district has had a lamp lit for it, the ground there lights up.
what.3: You can invite a friend to Porchlamps. Once they leave their first line, each of you gets a firework, and you have seven days to set it off. The link won't lead them to your house or your lines, and you won't know which line is theirs.
what.4: After you sign in, you can send a paper plane to a line you lit a lamp for tonight, or let one drift on the wind and land at the door of someone who left a line tonight. One plane a night. It only carries a few set phrases: you can't type, and no one can reply. You won't know if they open it. If no one opens it within 24 hours, it flies away.

about.keeper: A keeper reads every line and does their best to make sure everyone gets a lamp.
about.support: Porchlamps is looked after by one person, with no ads. If it has kept you company and you'd like to help keep it going, you can buy the author a coffee.
about.notService: Porchlamps is not a counseling or crisis service.
about.crisisLead: If you need someone to talk to right now:
about.translate: Porchlamps also wants to be understood by people in Hong Kong and elsewhere. If you'd like to help translate, you don't need to know how to code. You just translate one sentence at a time on a web page.
